newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PERSKOR CAUTIONS IT STILL IN TALKS.
newsitem.headline: PERSKOR CAUTIONS IT STILL IN TALKS.

text.p: Perskor Group Ltd said on Wednesday it was considering alternative methods to proceed with the acquisition of Kagiso Publishers (Pty) Ltd from Kagiso Trust Investments Company (Pty) Ltd and a reorganisation of the control structure of Perskor.
It urged shareholders to continue exercising caution in their dealings until a further announcement.
